answer: Filling 61 aliases therefore means producing 61 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Because the lantern count is verified against the ledge text itself, the copper audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
